guards.what: N1: the missing combat-end reset of the COUNTER -- .superpowers/sdd/content-relic-sweeps.md's Sweep A files this relic in the 'reset at TURN START, before any reader' bucket, a SAFETY CLAIM
guards.rationale: Executed rather than inherited, as PROMPT.md bug class 13 requires (trace to the first READER of the stale field). The only reader of `_attacks_this_turn` is on_card_played (ornamental_fan.py:35-36), and on_player_turn_start zeroes it before the play phase opens on turn 1 of every combat. EXECUTED (relic_probes_b10.py ornamental-fan): one relic instance through two consecutive combats grants 4 Block on the 3rd Attack in BOTH, and an instance hand-poisoned with `_attacks_this_turn = 2` entering a fresh combat reports 1 (not 3) after one Attack and grants 0 Block -- the turn-start reset shadowed the stale value. Note the C# side does not reset the counter at combat end either (see the AfterCombatEnd hook entry), so this is a case where the sweep's flag resolves to no divergence at all, not merely to a shadowed one. Contrast relic/belt_buckle, whose analogous missing reset has no turn-start shadow and is live, and relic/diamond_diadem, whose reset is turn-END only and therefore skipped by a winning turn. Rule 7: the sweeps document, relics/belt_buckle.py and relics/diamond_diadem.py are unhashed here.
